concerns.text: Leftover editing artifact after scenario 1: "The specific value to remove/generalize: 'k' / Rewritten passage:." — this is dangling revision scaffolding, not a requirement statement, and corrupts the US-2 acceptance scenario text. Remove it.

Two of three Edge Cases have no backing FR/SC: (a) undefined stereochemistry in SMILES ("normalize or flag, not crash") and (b) highly flexible molecules where 2D descriptors may fail ("error analysis should highlight these outliers") are stated goals with no FR or SC. Only the NaN case is covered (FR-006). Add FRs/SCs for stereochemistry handling and flexible-molecule outlier analysis, or explicitly descope them.
